label: Version 1.3.11
releaseNotes: Preserves authoritative Station IDs such as 675GB01 and 595GF01 without rejecting them because of an outdated length limit.
Adds searchable multi-select controls for paired SEOC and Situational SEOC values, including subset, use-all, clear, and saved-selection behavior.
Uses the existing option-card design for Referral Number, ICN, and Archive naming choices, with underscore-friendly custom Referral prefixes.
Keeps Referral Number, Network Name, Referral DateTime, and Custom archive naming modes with live JSON and gzip filename previews.
Sanitizes illegal filename characters and duplicate extensions while preserving user naming preferences across app restarts.
Makes Referral Number, ICN, processed-file, Station, Payment Authority Code, and Archive filename previews respond live to the current user choices.
Keeps Referral-derived ICNs in the required 17-character TEST format and reuses the computed ICN in custom Archive filename previews.
Places the regular and Situational SEOC Number - SEOC ID selectors side by side on standard desktop widths.
Uses VAiFAMS as one combined Referral Number prefix followed by the starting number or body.
Removes character limits from Referral Number bodies and custom Referral Number prefixes.
Keeps every Referral-derived ICN unique by shortening the end only when the 17-character ICN needs room for a uniqueness marker.
Shows clean names such as AUD_AUDIOLOGY in both SEOC selectors without trailing numbers or version text.
Makes Custom Archive naming easier with Select all and individual checkboxes for Referral Number, Referral Prefix, Network Name, Date, Date and Time, and Custom Text.
Uses one compact, polished option-card style across Referral Number, ICN, Archive naming, output behavior, and other equivalent choices.
Adds expandable in-app help for the five-step workflow, Referral and ICN behavior, output naming and safety, and optional uploads, with clearly marked live previews.
